_readme: Timestamped beat prose for STORY_020's comparative round (2.0s vs 3.0s conditioning). Twelve 10-second continuations, three beats each, matching the EPIC_001 A/B scenarios and their physical probes. Held identical across both arms so condition_seconds is the only variable. Each script carries the four properties that beat flat prose 10-1: M:SS sequencing, causal mechanism, explicit state continuity from the conditioning window, and audio intent in-band (the prose path never populates audio_description).
1:
0:00-0:03  The car creeps forward at walking pace, the front tyres crunching up onto the loose grey stones scattered across the near lane.
0:03-0:07  The dust still hanging in the air ahead drifts slowly left across the outside of the windscreen, thinning as the car pushes through it; inside, the dashboard and wiper blades stay sharp and clear.
0:07-0:10  The road ahead opens up to reveal the larger boulders and the ocean beyond, the last of the dust settling back down onto the asphalt.
2:
0:00-0:03  The car is still rolling toward the boulders blocking the road, carrying speed, the fallen rocks filling more of the windscreen.
0:03-0:07  The brakes bite and the car decelerates smoothly, the nose dipping forward as weight transfers onto the front suspension, gravel grinding under the slowing tyres.
0:07-0:10  The car comes to a complete stop a car's length short of the largest boulder and settles back on its springs, the road ahead still blocked by the rockfall.
3:
0:00-0:03  The robotic arm lowers the sponge steadily toward the centre of the plate, servos humming, the green scouring face held square in the black gripper.
0:03-0:07  The sponge meets the ceramic and compresses slightly against it, its lower edge flattening where it takes the load; the brown sauce residue already on the plate stays exactly where it is.
0:07-0:10  The arm holds the sponge pressed against the plate, the contact steady, the plate motionless on the granite counter beneath it.
4:
0:00-0:03  The robotic arm presses the sponge down onto the plate and begins a slow clockwise sweep, the green scouring face gripping the glazed ceramic.
0:03-0:07  The sauce residue smears along the path the sponge takes, gathering into a curved streak that follows the circular motion; the plate itself stays put on the counter, held down by its own weight.
0:07-0:10  The arm completes the circle and lifts slightly, leaving a cleared arc where the sponge passed and the remaining sauce pushed out toward the rim.
5:
0:00-0:03  The robotic arm tips the glass jar further and a steady stream of blue liquid runs from its mouth, falling vertically into the white mug below.
0:03-0:07  The stream continues under gravity and the level in the mug rises as it fills, small ripples spreading across the surface where the liquid lands; the jar empties by the same amount the mug gains.
0:07-0:10  The pour slows as the jar nears empty, the stream narrowing, the liquid in the mug settling flat and still.
6:
0:00-0:03  The robotic arm rotates the glass jar back upright, the blue liquid remaining inside settling level as it turns.
0:03-0:07  The arm lowers the jar steadily toward the table, the gripper holding it vertical, the base descending until it touches down on the surface.
0:07-0:10  The jar rests on the table taking its own weight, and the gripper opens and withdraws upward, leaving it standing upright beside the mug.
7:
0:00-0:03  The robotic arm lifts the sponge vertically away from the plate, the contact breaking cleanly as it rises.
0:03-0:07  The sponge keeps its rectangular shape in the gripper, yellow body and green scouring face square and undeformed, as the arm retracts upward and back.
0:07-0:10  The arm settles into its resting position above the counter, the sponge held steady in the claws, the clean white plate sitting undisturbed below.
8:
0:00-0:03  The car begins reversing slowly, the scattered rocks in the foreground starting to recede as the viewpoint pulls back down the road.
0:03-0:07  The rockfall and cliff face shrink steadily in the windscreen, the nearer rocks sliding out of frame faster than the distant headland, the road markings drawing back beneath the car.
0:07-0:10  The car keeps backing away, revealing more of the empty road behind and the ocean to the right, the rockfall now small in the distance ahead.
9:
0:00-0:03  The scene is lit brightly, sunlight striking the textured rock face and glaring off the sea to the right.
0:03-0:07  A cloud drifts across the sun and the light dims progressively, the shadows on the cliff deepening and spreading down across the debris-strewn road, the glare fading from the water.
0:07-0:10  The scene settles into flat overcast light, the rock face uniformly shaded, the fallen rocks still lying in the road and the car still stationary.
10:
0:00-0:03  The stream of blue liquid thins as the jar empties, narrowing from a steady flow down to a single thread.
0:03-0:07  The thread breaks and the flow stops; a heavy drop gathers on the rim of the jar's mouth, hangs there a moment, then falls into the mug and splashes on the surface of the liquid already in it.
0:07-0:10  A second smaller drop follows and lands, the surface in the mug settling flat; the jar stays tilted in the gripper, empty.
11:
0:00-0:03  The robotic arm lifts the sponge clear of the plate and moves it laterally across the granite counter.
0:03-0:07  The arm lowers the sponge toward the bare counter beside the plate, its underside meeting the stone and settling flat as the gripper takes the weight off it.
0:07-0:10  The black gripper claws open and withdraw upward, leaving the sponge resting on the counter, holding its shape beside the clean white plate.
12:
0:00-0:03  The robotic arm pushes the sponge away from the camera, sliding it across the plate toward the far rim.
0:03-0:07  As the sponge crosses the plate the raised near rim passes in front of its lower edge, hiding the bottom of the sponge from view while its top stays visible above the rim line.
0:07-0:10  The sponge reaches the far edge and stops, still partly occluded by the near rim, the sauce residue smeared along the path it took.
